main_text.l: כֵּן Rectum, Recte: Sic, Ita: Bafis, quomodo cum Affixis recipit Dagefch : ut כֵּנוּ Bafis ejus: Plur. כֵּנִים. Hinc לָכֵן, עַל־כֵּן Propter-ea, Idcirco, Ideo, Quapropter: עַד־כֵּן Hucusque, Hactenus, אָכֵן Certè.
מָכוֹן m. Bafis, Sedes, Locus: plural. מְכוֹנִים Fœm. מְכוֹנָה vel מְכוּנָה, plural. מְכוֹנוֹת.
כּוֹס f. Calix, Poculum: plur. כּוֹסוֹת. Item, Bubo, avis.
כֹּר m. Corus: plur. כּוֹרִים, & Chald. כּוּרִין.
כּוּשׁ Chusch nomen proprium viri, qui Aethiopibus nomen dedit, כּוּשִׁי Aethiops: plur. כּוּשִׁים. Fœm. כּוּשִׁית Aethiopissa.
כָּזַב Pihel כִּזֵּב Mentiri. Niphal נִכְזַב Mendacem effici. Hiphil הִכְזִיב Mendacem efficere.
אַכְזָר כּוֹר m. Crudelis, Ferox, Savus.

page.notes: The Hebrew vowel points and dagesh are reproduced from a reduced scan and may be imperfect, especially in the lines beside the stain at the right. The line with כּוּשׁ and the Hiphil form in the Pihel/Niphal entry are the least certain.
